record.paper: Extension of Gyarfas-Sumner conjecture to digraphs

dossier_meta.paper: Extension of Gyarfas-Sumner conjecture to digraphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: What are the finite sets $\mathcal{F}$ of digraphs for which the class $\mathrm{Forb}_{\mathrm{ind}}(\mathcal{F})$ has bounded dichromatic number?
dossier_meta.context_text: This is the central problem of the paper, extending the Gyárfás-Sumner interrogation to directed graphs via the dichromatic number $\vec{\chi}$. A finite set $\mathcal{F}$ of digraphs is called heroic if $\mathrm{Forb}_{\mathrm{ind}}(\mathcal{F})$ has bounded dichromatic number. The paper focuses primarily on characterizing heroic sets of size three.
